Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model

Record Class RegulatoryEvent

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.RegulatoryEvent
Record Components:
eventId - unique identifier (UUID)
eventType - classification of the regulatory action
regulatoryBody - issuing federal agency (FDA, CMS, ONC)
title - human-readable event title
summary - short description or AI-generated summary (nullable)
referenceNumber - e.g. "K241234" for 510(k), "DEN210040" for De Novo (nullable)
applicantName - company/entity that filed (nullable)
deviceName - device or product name (nullable)
sourceUrl - original source URL
linkedArticleId - FK to NewsArticle.articleId() if one exists (nullable)
publishedAt - when the regulatory event was published/effective (nullable)
discoveredAt - when our system first discovered this event
aiHealthcareKeywords - extracted keywords relevant to AI/healthcare
outcomeStatus - lifecycle status (PENDING, CLEARED, APPROVED, etc.) — nullable
outcomeUpdatedAt - when the outcome was last checked or changed — nullable
clearanceType - 510(k) clearance pathway (Traditional, Special, Abbreviated) — nullable
predicateDeviceNumber - predicate device reference for 510(k) (e.g. "K192345") — nullable
public record RegulatoryEvent(String eventId, RegulatoryEventType eventType, RegulatoryBody regulatoryBody, String title, String summary, String referenceNumber, String applicantName, String deviceName, String sourceUrl, String linkedArticleId, Instant publishedAt, Instant discoveredAt, List<String> aiHealthcareKeywords, RegulatoryOutcomeStatus outcomeStatus, Instant outcomeUpdatedAt, String clearanceType, String predicateDeviceNumber) extends Record
Immutable domain record representing a regulatory event relevant to AI in healthcare.

Covers FDA 510(k) clearances, De Novo classifications, CMS rules, and other regulatory actions. Each event carries structured metadata (reference numbers, applicant names, device names) that plain NewsArticle records cannot express. The optional linkedArticleId bridges to an originating article when one exists.
